exposure.needed: whether Flux was installed using the bootstrap procedure, the Git repository and --path bootstrap was run against, and which extra Flux components (e.g. image automation) were enabled at bootstrap

original.statement: For environments where Flux was installed using the bootstrap procedure, upgrading the Flux controllers to this release is an operator step: generate the new Kubernetes manifests with the Flux CLI and push them to the Git repository where bootstrap was run (including any extra components enabled at bootstrap), or rerun the bootstrap command for each cluster using the same arguments as before.

decision.reason: [ev-b1e8ad65539c] is the general Flux upgrade guide. It explains how to upgrade bootstrapped controllers, either by pushing regenerated manifests to Git or by rerunning bootstrap. It does not say that anything was added, removed or changed in 2.7.0. With no change to be exposed to, any exposure condition (including this undecidable one about bootstrap installs) is wrong, and no correct assertion follows from this evidence.
